hook.name: TripoolsAntiSnipeHook
hook.description: Anti-snipe and dynamic-fee tax hook serving all TripoolsLaunchFactory pools. Enforces a 6-second anti-snipe window with a flat 50% tax on non-whitelisted buys (100% to protocol treasury), and a cycling tiered tax schedule on ordinary buys and sells, split 20%/80% between protocol treasury and token creator, always collected in ETH via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta.
